FRENCH — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #12
====

GRADE: Grade 7
SUBJECT: FRENCH
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KJSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. When practising Interactive Speaking, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Avoid reading anything related to Interactive Speaking.
   B. Use insults to “practise” Interactive Speaking.
   C. Copy random text without understanding Interactive Speaking.
   D. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Interactive Speaking.

   D. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Active listening 1.4 Listening for information.

   A. Good morning / hello
   B. Thank you
   C. Good night only
   D. Excuse me

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
11. In three clear sentences, explain Guided Writing Orthography Vocabulary Letter formation and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
